title: Session-prefix cost harmonizer with late-arrival correction pipeline
creator: Asha Patel
description: Implement a resilient pipeline that harmonizes token-level cost attribution at the session-prefix granularity, including bounded late-arrival correction, per-token lineage, and a safe backfill strategy for historical windows.
background: Current billing attribution aggregates at route-level and frequently misattributes costs for interleaved sessions and late-arriving tokens (edge proxies, retries, cross-region replays). This causes customer-facing discrepancies and manual adjustments. We need an automated pipeline that produces deterministic, auditable per-session prefix accounting and supports retroactive corrections without destabilizing downstream invoicing flows.
scope: Architect and ship a streaming reconciliation worker that produces session-prefix cost deltas
Add per-request lineage fields to token telemetry (lineage_id, prefix_window_id, ingest_watermark)
Design a bounded correction/backfill worker for late arrivals (max lookback: 7 days configurable)
Expose a queryable ledger table optimized for per-customer delta pulls and invoice generation
Integrate with Console dashboards and alerting for attribution drift
approach: Ingest enriched per-token events from the streaming gateway and tag with lineage_id and session_prefix hash
Maintain an append-only event-store partitioned by customer and prefix_window, emit compacted cost deltas once watermark advances
Apply idempotent write semantics using event fencing (ledger_write_id derived from lineage_id + shard)
Run a late-arrival correction pass: compute delta between emitted window and truth-set; emit compensating delta records that are annotated as corrective
Shadow-run changes against current billing pipeline for two weeks; acceptance criteria: <0.5% delta in billed totals and no regression in latency
data_model_changes: New table: session_prefix_ledger(customer_id, prefix_window_id, emitted_at_iso, total_tokens, total_cost_micros, lineage_ids, correction_flag)
Token telemetry schema: add lineage_id (uuid), prefix_window_id (string), ingest_watermark (iso timestamp)
Compact representation: exposure_map for multi-route fanout preserved as array of route:tokens strings
Index: (customer_id, prefix_window_id) for fast invoice reads
migration_plan: Phase 1 (shadow/parallel): Write to session_prefix_ledger in parallel with existing aggregates; do not drive billing
Phase 2 (canary): Route a small set of test customers (non-critical) to ledger-based invoicing and compare results
Phase 3 (gradual rollout): Increase customer coverage by 10% weekly while monitoring drift and correction rates
Backfill approach: time-bucketed compaction worker that replays raw events into prefix windows with rate-limits and memory bounds
rollout_plan: Deploy ingestion schema changes behind a feature flag (gateway will send lineage fields only when flag enabled)
Start shadow run for 14 days, collect discrepancy metrics and run reconciliation daily
Enable customer read API for sample customers to validate ledger outputs
After stability window (14 days, drift <0.5%) flip canary customers to use ledger outputs for billing
Schedule full migration cutover during low-traffic weekend with multi-hour maintenance window and rollback playbook
acceptance_criteria: Session_prefix_ledger populated for all events in shadow run with <0.1% ingestion loss
Late-arrival correction worker emits compensating deltas with clear audit trail and corrected totals converge within 48 hours
End-to-end delta between legacy billing and ledger-based billing <0.5% for canary cohort
Console shows per-prefix lineage trace for sampled requests and the new dashboard charts (correction rate, average correction size)
Automated integration tests for idempotent ledger writes and rollback scenarios added to CI
tasks: Schema: add lineage_id and prefix_window_id to token telemetry and migrate producers
Worker: implement streaming prefix aggregator with watermarking and compaction
Correction: implement bounded late-arrival correction pass with compensating emits
API: ledger read endpoints for console and invoicing jobs
Backfill: time-bucketed backfill runner with rate limiting and progress checkpoints
Observability: dashboards, alerts (drift >0.5%), and per-lineage trace link generation
Docs: Confluence runbook, run / rollback procedures, and data retention policy
